name: Vin Gris
summary: Vin Gris blends sculptural presence with tonal harmony. The body and fiberglass base are both finished in a rich dual-shade lacquer, offering a subtle depth that plays with light. Inner panels in warm melamine enhance the contrast, while matte black metal connectors and reinforcement tubing ground the piece with strength and precision. A refined composition for contemporary luxury interiors. 200x43x79
